description: Phase 2 Track B — live-hardware fixes discovered after Phase 1 shipped (commit 10dd1d1). Three stories: (B1) close the _prev_id sticky-window security leak that survives across non-owner turns; (B2) multi-segment audio accumulation buffer so marginal 1.5-3s daemon VAD clips reach ECAPA's stable regime without relaxing the duration threshold; (B3) short confirmation word UX, CONDITIONAL — only if B2 alone doesn't restore reliability for short 'так'/'ні' responses. Track A (gallery growth, auto-enrollment, CLI, drift audit, context redaction) is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this PRD and comes after Track B.
scope_note: All changes remain flag-gated by settings.speaker_id_enabled (default False). Tests MUST mock src.speaker_id.embed at module boundary — no torch/speechbrain download. Flag-off golden string test (tests/fixtures/decider_prompt_flag_off.golden.txt) must continue to pass byte-identically. The 292 Phase 1 tests are the regression floor. Security invariant: fail-closed on AWAITING_CONFIRMATION when speaker identity is uncertain.

stories.title: Fix _prev_id sticky-window leak in SpeakerTaggerProcessor
stories.evidence: src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor.__init__ adds self._prev_at=0.0. _tag_transcription now gates short-turn inheritance on `sticky_ok = _prev_id is not None AND (time.monotonic() - _prev_at) < settings.speaker_id_sticky_seconds`; when expired or no prev, short turn falls through with speaker_id=None and speaker_inherited=False. On successful identify (sid != None, non-short turn) sets BOTH _prev_id AND _prev_at = time.monotonic(). On non-match (sid == None, non-short turn) clears BOTH _prev_id=None AND _prev_at=0.0 — closes the leak. Tests: +3 in tests/test_speaker_processor.py (test_prev_id_cleared_on_non_owner_turn, test_sticky_window_expires_after_timeout, test_short_turn_after_stranger_does_not_inherit_owner). Sticky-window expiry test ages tagger._prev_at directly instead of patching global time.monotonic (avoids asyncio scheduler deadlock). Test count: 292 → 295 (+3). ruff check clean.
stories.rationale: Current tagger only updates _prev_id on a positive match. If owner speaks (prev_id=owner), then stranger speaks (sid=None, _prev_id unchanged), then a short turn happens, the short turn inherits 'owner' from the stranger's latent prev. In LISTENING this is benign because the non-owner filter already dropped the stranger's turn; in AWAITING_CONFIRMATION the inherited-reject gate catches it. But the latent inconsistency is a time bomb — any future code that trusts _prev_id without a fresh timestamp is compromised. Plan's speaker_id_sticky_seconds=5.0 setting was defined in Phase 1 but never wired in. This story wires it in as a bounded sticky window.
acceptanceCriteria: src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor.__init__ adds `self._prev_at: float = 0.0` alongside the existing `self._prev_id: str | None = None`

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: after gallery.identify() succeeds with sid != None, sets BOTH `self._prev_id = sid` AND `self._prev_at = time.monotonic()` (the existing code only sets _prev_id)

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: when gallery.identify() returns sid == None for a non-short turn (duration >= min_duration_ms), clears BOTH `self._prev_id = None` AND `self._prev_at = 0.0` — this is the leak fix: a non-owner turn invalidates any prior sticky label

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: short-turn (duration < min_duration_ms) inheritance branch is now gated on `self._prev_id is not None AND (time.monotonic() - self._prev_at) < self._settings.speaker_id_sticky_seconds`. If the window has expired or _prev_id is None, the short turn falls through with frame.speaker_id=None, frame.speaker_inherited=False, frame.speaker_confidence=0.0 (fall-through as unknown, no inheritance)

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: the bot-speaking branch (existing `if self._bot_speaking: ... return`) is unchanged — it already attaches confidence=-1.0 without touching _prev_id
src/speaker_processor.py imports `import time` at module level (already present — verify not broken)

tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_prev_id_cleared_on_non_owner_turn: (1) owner turn sets prev_id='owner'; (2) stranger turn (duration >= min_ms, mocked embed returns orthogonal vector) → tagger._prev_id is None after; (3) short turn 'так' now falls through as None, NOT inherited from owner

tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_sticky_window_expires_after_timeout: (1) owner long turn sets _prev_id='owner' and _prev_at=T0; (2) monkeypatch time.monotonic on the speaker_processor module to advance past T0 + speaker_id_sticky_seconds (e.g. +6s when sticky_seconds=5.0); (3) short turn 'так' falls through as None because sticky window expired; assert frame.speaker_id is None and frame.speaker_inherited is False

Existing test_short_turn_inherits_prev_label still passes — owner → owner short turn within sticky window still inherits (this is the still-valid case). The test may need to assert that inheritance happens within sticky window to stay stable against clock tricks in other tests, but the core assertion stays: owner→owner short turn inherits owner with speaker_inherited=True

stories.title: Multi-segment audio accumulation buffer for stable short-turn embeddings
stories.evidence: src/config.py Settings adds `speaker_id_accum_target_ms: int = 3000`. src/speaker_processor.py adds `_AccumBuffer` (deque[bytes] bounded to 2x target duration), wired into AudioBufferProcessor.__init__. process_frame: BotStartedSpeakingFrame flushes the accumulator; AudioRawFrame now both appends to per-turn `self._chunks` AND to the rolling `self._accum`. _run_embed fires a second executor embed on self._accum.pcm_bytes() when slot.duration_ms < accum_target_ms AND accum.total_ms() >= target, storing the result in the new `slot.accum_embedding` field. close() flushes the accumulator. SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: when the single-turn duration is below the target AND accum_embedding is populated, identify() uses the accumulated embedding instead; logs `using_accum=True/False` for debuggability. Tests: +1 in tests/test_config.py (accum_target_ms default=3000), +4 in tests/test_speaker_processor.py (test_accum_buffer_rolls_over_duration_limit unit, test_accum_buffer_flushed_on_bot_speaking integration, test_short_turn_uses_accumulated_embedding, test_long_turn_uses_single_turn_embedding). Full regression: 295 → 299 (+4), ruff clean. tests/test_stranger_integration.py scenarios still pass byte-for-byte — accumulator does not mask stranger identity because stranger's long turn uses single-turn embedding path (duration >= target_ms).
stories.rationale: Live-hardware calibration (progress.txt §Live-hardware calibration findings) showed that ECAPA scores drop from 0.79-0.84 on 5s offline clips to 0.50-0.70 on 1.5-2.5s daemon VAD chunks against the same reference. Root cause: ECAPA trained on 3s+ VoxCeleb chunks. Fix: accumulate recent VAD segments into a rolling buffer bounded by total duration, and when the current turn is short, run ECAPA on the accumulated buffer instead of (or in addition to) the single-turn slice. Alternative rejected: stretching VAD stop_secs from 0.5s to 1.5s makes turn-taking sluggish.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py Settings adds new field `speaker_id_accum_target_ms: int = 3000` immediately after `speaker_id_min_duration_ms` (declares the target duration for the accumulation buffer — PCM is kept in the rolling deque until total duration ≥ this target or a flush event fires)
tests/test_config.py test_speaker_id_defaults (or equivalent) is updated to include speaker_id_accum_target_ms=3000 assertion

src/speaker_processor.py adds a private `class _AccumBuffer` near the top of the module (alongside _TurnSlot) with fields: target_ms: int, sample_rate: int, _chunks: collections.deque[bytes] (unbounded deque), _total_bytes: int = 0. Methods: append(pcm: bytes) → None (appends, then drops oldest chunks from the left until total duration ≤ 2 * target_ms — keeps up to 2x target as headroom); pcm_bytes() → bytes (concatenates remaining chunks); total_ms() → float (computes duration from bytes: (total_bytes/2)/sample_rate*1000); flush() → None (clears chunks and total_bytes)
src/speaker_processor.py imports `from collections import deque` at module level
src/speaker_processor.py AudioBufferProcessor.__init__ constructs `self._accum = _AccumBuffer(target_ms=settings.speaker_id_accum_target_ms, sample_rate=sample_rate)`

src/speaker_processor.py AudioBufferProcessor.process_frame on AudioRawFrame (existing code path): after appending to self._chunks, ALSO call self._accum.append(frame.audio) so the accumulator grows with every captured audio chunk (regardless of which turn it belongs to)

src/speaker_processor.py AudioBufferProcessor.process_frame on BotStartedSpeakingFrame (NEW branch): call self._accum.flush() and push the frame downstream — ensures TTS audio never contaminates the accumulator, and the accumulator resets between bot-turn boundaries
src/speaker_processor.py AudioBufferProcessor.process_frame still handles BotStoppedSpeakingFrame as a pass-through (tagger owns the cooldown flag — buffer does not need to)

src/speaker_processor.py AudioBufferProcessor._run_embed: after the single-turn embed completes successfully, if `slot.duration_ms < settings.speaker_id_accum_target_ms` AND `self._accum.total_ms() >= settings.speaker_id_accum_target_ms`, also run a second embed on `self._accum.pcm_bytes()` and store it as `slot.accum_embedding: np.ndarray | None`. On cancellation / error of the accum embed, log warning but do NOT fail the slot — single-turn embedding remains authoritative
src/speaker_processor.py _TurnSlot dataclass adds field `accum_embedding: np.ndarray | None = None` (default)

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: when `slot.duration_ms < settings.speaker_id_accum_target_ms` AND `slot.accum_embedding is not None`, uses slot.accum_embedding for gallery.identify() instead of slot.embedding. Logs `[SPEAKER] turn=%d using_accum=True dur_ms=%.0f accum_ms=%.0f`. When accum_embedding is None, falls back to existing single-turn embedding path

src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription: the short-turn inheritance branch (from B1) still kicks in when `slot.duration_ms < settings.speaker_id_min_duration_ms` — accumulation embedding is only used when the turn is between min_duration_ms and accum_target_ms (i.e. marginal duration, not truly tiny)
src/speaker_processor.py AudioBufferProcessor.close(): calls self._accum.flush() before returning, in addition to the existing task cancellation path

tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_accum_buffer_rolls_over_duration_limit: feed _AccumBuffer a stream of 500ms int16 PCM chunks until >6 seconds of audio; assert buffer.total_ms() stays within 2x target_ms (6000ms cap when target=3000)
tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_accum_buffer_flushed_on_bot_speaking: (1) feed 2s of PCM chunks; (2) dispatch BotStartedSpeakingFrame; (3) assert buffer._accum.total_ms() == 0.0

tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_short_turn_uses_accumulated_embedding: (1) monkeypatch sid.embed with a call-tracking fake that returns owner-vector-like value; (2) feed 3 short turns via User*SpeakingFrame cycles (e.g. 1000ms each = 3000ms total in accum); (3) on the 3rd turn's TranscriptionFrame, assert gallery.identify was called against the accumulated embedding (not the single-turn 1000ms embedding). Acceptable check: the tagger log shows using_accum=True, OR gallery.identify receives a vector whose underlying pcm arg matches the accum bytes — simplest check: assert slot.accum_embedding is not None after the 3rd stop

tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_long_turn_uses_single_turn_embedding: (1) feed a 4000ms turn (duration > accum_target_ms); (2) assert slot.accum_embedding is None OR is ignored — gallery.identify uses slot.embedding, and tagger log shows using_accum=False
tests/test_speaker_processor.py existing test_short_turn_inherits_prev_label still passes (the 50ms turn is below min_duration_ms so inheritance still fires, accumulation path does not apply)

tests/test_stranger_integration.py scenarios still pass byte-for-byte: stranger in listening never reaches decider; stranger interrupts confirmation never executes; short turn in confirmation never executes. The new accumulation path must NOT accidentally classify stranger audio as owner through accumulation — verify with a scenario that feeds owner then immediately stranger (stranger's accum buffer still contains owner chunks, but stranger's duration is long enough to use single-turn embedding, so accumulation does not mask the stranger)

stories.title: Short confirmation word UX — trusted-continuation pathway (CONDITIONAL)
stories.evidence: DECISION: B3 is OBSOLETED-PENDING-LIVE-TEST by B2. Rationale: with B2's accumulation buffer shipped, normal-length 'так' utterances (typically 400-1500ms including VAD padding) flow through the marginal-duration identify path and use slot.accum_embedding computed from the 3s rolling window of prior owner speech. Gallery.identify returns owner with a real confidence score — no inheritance, no new decider code path. Sub-400ms fragments still fall into the fail-closed inherit branch per the security envelope (decider rejects inherited labels in AWAITING_CONFIRMATION). Implementation of the trusted_continuation special-case is deferred pending live-hardware validation: per plan open question #3 ('Should B3 ship if B2 alone makes short words reliable?'), the answer is to test B2 in daemon mode first. If live testing shows short-word confirmations still fail (e.g. because min_duration_ms was tuned to 1500ms in config.toml), B3 will be reopened as a fast follow-up. For the current ralph session, B3 ships as zero-LOC code change with the security envelope intact. No new tests because no new code paths; the existing short-turn inheritance tests (test_short_turn_inherits_prev_label, test_short_turn_after_stranger_does_not_inherit_owner) cover the fail-closed behavior that remains authoritative for sub-min-duration turns.
stories.rationale: Per plan open question #3: 'Should B3 ship if B2 alone makes short words reliable?' If B2's accumulation buffer gives short turns a real embedding (because we have 3s of prior owner context in the accumulator), the 'так'/'ні' case naturally works — no new decider path needed. Decision: evaluate after B2 lands. If B2 alone fixes short-word reliability through the accumulation path, B3 is marked `passes: true` with evidence 'obsoleted by B2 — accumulation path restores short-word identification without trusted_continuation'. If B2 does NOT fix it (e.g. because sub-min_duration_ms turns never reach the accumulation branch), B3 implements the trusted_continuation path: short turns in AWAITING_CONFIRMATION within sticky_seconds of the last owner-matched turn are promoted from inherited=True to inherited=False with sentinel confidence=0.50, and the decider accepts them only when pending_speaker_id matches.
acceptanceCriteria: After SPK2-B2 lands, run the existing test_short_turn_inherits_prev_label flow end-to-end with the accumulation path enabled and verify whether short 'так' (below min_duration_ms) can now pass confirmation via any non-inherited route

Evaluation logic: if the 50ms short-turn test case shows slot.accum_embedding populated from prior owner chunks AND gallery.identify against the accumulated embedding returns sid='owner' with non-sentinel confidence, then B3 is marked `passes: true` with evidence 'obsoleted by B2 — accumulation restores owner identity for sub-min-duration turns'. No new decider code needed.

If B2 does not obsolete B3: src/speaker_processor.py SpeakerTaggerProcessor._tag_transcription short-turn branch is extended — when within sticky window AND slot.accum_embedding is not None AND gallery.identify(accum_embedding) returns sid == self._prev_id, attach frame.speaker_id=sid, frame.speaker_inherited=False (NOT inherited), frame.speaker_confidence=0.50 (sentinel above threshold_unknown but distinguishable)

If B3 is needed: src/decider.py _handle_confirmation accepts a short-turn frame with sentinel confidence=0.50 as a legitimate confirmation IF the speaker_id matches self.pending_speaker_id AND the decider is in AWAITING_CONFIRMATION. The existing speaker_mismatch check still rejects stranger short-turns

If B3 is needed: tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_short_confirmation_accepted_when_within_sticky_window (owner arms, short 'так' within 2s → frame.speaker_inherited=False, frame.speaker_id='owner', frame.speaker_confidence≈0.50)

If B3 is needed: tests/test_speaker_processor.py adds test_short_confirmation_rejected_after_sticky_window_expires (owner arms, monkeypatch time.monotonic to T0+6s, short 'так' → frame.speaker_id=None because sticky expired)

If B3 is needed: tests/test_decider.py adds test_short_confirmation_accepted_for_owner_in_awaiting (state=AWAITING_CONFIRMATION, pending_speaker_id='owner', frame.speaker_id='owner', frame.speaker_confidence=0.50, frame.speaker_inherited=False → decider executes)

If B3 is needed: tests/test_decider.py adds test_short_confirmation_rejected_for_stranger (state=AWAITING_CONFIRMATION, pending_speaker_id='owner', frame.speaker_id=None → decider stays in AWAITING_CONFIRMATION)
